root_parent_outcome: OPEN: prospectively pre-frozen nonstigma source natal predictor against untouched consented people, fair decoys and nonastrology baselines

historical_claim_source.meaning: Colonial Yucatec Chuen birth-day attribute: carpenter, weaver, skilled maker; not a claim about hours, all modern creative hobbies, or a modern Yucatec continuously practiced calendar

independent_prior_work.title: International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08)
independent_prior_work.usable_for: Coding paid/self-employed craft work by actual tasks; major group 7 and narrower selected unit codes. Not a natal validation measure on its own.
independent_prior_work.limits: Classification of JOB TASKS, not interest, craft skill by itself, unpaid hobbies, medical fate, or results of a birth chart.

independent_prior_work.kind: official legal publication of unit groups
independent_prior_work.title: EU Recommendation 2009/824/EC Annex ISCO-08 structure
independent_prior_work.usable_for: Narrowly defined unit codes for skilled crafts, wood and textiles
independent_prior_work.limits: The narrower primary-code subset is an investigator's source-specific selection, not an official ILO Chuen taxonomy.

independent_prior_work.title: American Time Use Survey Coding Lexicons (2024/2025 and 2003–2025)
independent_prior_work.reference_category: 120309 (2003–24 classification): arts and crafts as a hobby
independent_prior_work.usable_for: Operational examples and optional diary coding of leisure craft
independent_prior_work.limits: ATUS 120309 is leisure-only and cannot be substituted for paid woodworking/weaving work. Photography/social-media content examples also exceed the physical-makings source scope.

independent_prior_work.title: UN Statistics Division Guidelines for Producing Statistics on Time Use
independent_prior_work.usable_for: Short reference period/diary and weekdays coverage to reduce retrospective recall load
independent_prior_work.limits: Diaries of one week can miss seasonal/irregular craft practice and are not a 12-month lifetime maker trait.

independent_prior_work.title: COSMIN methodology for evaluating content validity of patient-reported outcome measures: a Delphi study
independent_prior_work.usable_for: Three separate checks: construct relevance, coverage of content and respondent comprehension with cognitive interviews
independent_prior_work.limits: Originally for PROMs; adapt process as a general instrument-design discipline without asserting this craft survey is COSMIN certified.

independent_prior_work.title: Measurement Error in Stylized and Diary Data on Time Use
independent_prior_work.usable_for: Stylized retrospectively reported hours can exhibit systematic and random errors versus diary estimates
independent_prior_work.limits: Housework sample, not direct evidence of bias direction for this Maya craft question.

candidate_primary_options.meaning: Current or previous substantial task-based craft trade, paid, self-employed, subsistence or apprenticeship (record form separately; ISCO code only applies to occupational tasks).
candidate_primary_options.observable: Blind-coded occupation tasks / actual activities, not self-label of being creative or a high-status artisan
candidate_primary_options.source_alignment: High for carpenter/weaver occupational terms; imperfect for purely voluntary unpaid crafts and latent skill
candidate_primary_options.measurement: Private open description of main and supplementary work tasks, materials/tool skills and 12-month participation duration; blinded dual coding to narrow ISCO
candidate_primary_options.possible_bias: Local employment opportunity and socioeconomic status; people without formal jobs may have craft skill; career access is not natal causation

candidate_primary_options.meaning: Regular making, weaving, carpentry or related physical crafts for compensation or voluntarily (including personal, household and cultural handicrafts).
candidate_primary_options.observable: Frequency in past 4 weeks (0, less than monthly cannot fit 4-week window; use no/1/2-3/4+ sessions and a distinct 12-month any-session history)
candidate_primary_options.source_alignment: Measures enactment, not historical occupation/skill; gives opportunity-adjusted secondary contrast
candidate_primary_options.measurement: Short past-month behavior frequency with examples; avoid mixing digital content creation or all repair chores
candidate_primary_options.possible_bias: Seasonal crafts, household need, economic access and language may change behavior; 4 weeks may undercapture.

candidate_primary_options.meaning: Hours making tangible things paid + unpaid during last 12 months in 6 ordinal buckets
candidate_primary_options.observable: Self reported annual time allocation, source indirectly
candidate_primary_options.source_alignment: Broader than artisan occupational state; high recall burden and less literal
candidate_primary_options.measurement: Earlier B09 working instrument, keep for descriptive comparison only unless reviewer selects it prospectively
candidate_primary_options.possible_bias: Systematic and random error in stylized time estimates; paid-work hours may dominate resulting difference

candidate_primary_options.meaning: Short logged interval of daily craft work/hobby activities
candidate_primary_options.observable: Minutes and type of tangible object-making activity on each of 7 days (weekday/weekend coverage); paid job and leisure separate
candidate_primary_options.source_alignment: Nearer to observed behavior, but 7 days can miss irregular artisan work
candidate_primary_options.measurement: BLS ATUS-inspired diary with task categories and free description; NOT formally ATUS-conformant, no paid work in leisure code 120309
candidate_primary_options.possible_bias: Diary reactivity, seasonal/workday bias and rare behaviors

codebook_proposed_questions.neutral_en: Describe the main tasks you did in your main and any supplementary work during the past 12 months. What physical things did you make or repair, if any?
For work involving skilled physical making or repair, was it your regular paid or self-employed activity, unpaid/apprenticeship activity, or neither?
In the past 4 weeks, on how many occasions did you make or repair physical objects using craft skills, paid or unpaid?
Over the past year, did you do any skilled object-making tasks that did not happen in the past 4 weeks?
What did you make or repair most recently, if anything?
codebook_proposed_questions.format: optional free response with no private identifiers

codebook_proposed_questions.neutral_en: For each of seven consecutive days record approximate time and work/leisure type spent physically making or repairing objects.

measurement_review_protocol.example_review_count: 3–6 cognitive participants if available; design estimate only, NOT a regulatory minimum

code_source_verification.source_title: Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (Luxembourg): ISCO codes
code_source_verification.method: read code and title pair in official online listing; no population labels or natal outcomes accessed
